name: What are the benefits of replacing an old front door with an energy-efficient model?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of replacing an old front door with an energy-efficient model?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing an old front door with an energy-efficient model can significantly improve your home's insulation, reducing heat loss in winter and heat gain in summer. This leads to lower energy bills and a more comfortable indoor environment. Modern energy-efficient doors often feature advanced weatherstripping, insulated cores, and better-sealing frames. This upgrade not only saves money on utilities but also contributes to a quieter home by reducing outside noise.
acceptedAnswer.description: An energy-efficient front door improves insulation, lowers energy bills, enhances indoor comfort, and reduces outside noise.
